notes: 0.3.47：没同步上的文件现在处处可见。① 每条被跳过的文件都进清单 ~\.dsh\sync-notices.json（四类 too-large / history / skipped / failed）：capture 对 >100 MB 直接跳过；提交前索引预检把 ≥95 MB 从暂存区撤出并写进 .git\info\exclude 后再提交，其余照推；50–95 MB 只警告不拦。② 退出后的进度窗口在「同步已完成」横幅之前按类汇总（每组最多 5 条，超出给「…还有 N 个，完整清单：<路径>」）。③ 配置同步面板「上次自动同步」卡底部加常驻黄框：分类计数 + 最多 30 条明细 + 「文件仍在本机，只是没进仓库；下次同步自动复查」。④ push 前还做一次历史预检（git ls-tree -r -l HEAD），命中 ≥95 MB 就提前报「远端会拒收整次推送（不是网络问题）」，给两条路：换一份新的空仓库（初始化推送），或 git filter-repo 清史后强推——只报告，不自动改史。⑤ git push 的原始输出按特征归类（File … exceeds … limit = 文件超限 / quota、repository size = 仓库总量 / remote rejected、pre-receive hook declined = 远端拒收 / permission、publickey、host key、resolve host、timed out = 网络认证），不再一律报「网络/认证失败」。实测（隔离仓库 + 本地裸库 + 假 pre-receive）：96 MB 文件被剔除后其余照推成功且 notices 落盘 too-large=1；同一文件进历史后预检报 history=1；hook 回放 GitHub 报文被归成「1 个文件超过单文件上限」而不是网络问题；顺手修掉两处老坑：`-replace` 传反斜杠替换串会报正则无效、`-f` 与多段字符串拼接混用导致 {0} 原样打印。
notesEn: 0.3.47: files that never made it into the repo are now visible everywhere. (1) Every skipped file is recorded in ~\.dsh\sync-notices.json (four kinds: too-large / history / skipped / failed): capture skips anything over 100 MB; the pre-commit index precheck unstages ≥95 MB into .git\info\exclude and pushes the rest; 50–95 MB only warns. (2) The post-exit progress window prints a grouped summary before the "sync finished" banner (5 rows per group, plus "…and N more, full list: <path>"). (3) The config-sync panel gets a permanent warning box at the bottom of the "last auto sync" card: per-kind counts, up to 30 rows, and "still on this machine, just not in the repo". (4) A history precheck (git ls-tree -r -l HEAD) runs before pushing: a ≥95 MB hit is reported as "the remote will reject the whole push (not a network problem)" with two ways out — a fresh empty repo, or git filter-repo plus a force push; report only, history is never rewritten. (5) Raw git push output is classified (File … exceeds … limit = file too large / quota, repository size = repo quota / remote rejected, pre-receive hook declined = remote rejection / permission, publickey, host key, resolve host, timed out = network or auth) instead of always reporting a network/auth failure. Measured on an isolated repo with a local bare remote and a fake pre-receive hook: the 96 MB file was unstaged and the rest pushed, with notices recording too-large=1; the same file in history produced history=1; a replayed GitHub message was classified as "1 file over the cap". Two old traps fixed along the way: a backslash replacement string made -replace throw "regular expression pattern \ is not valid", and -f mixed with concatenated strings printed a literal {0}.
